cues.text: Your room in the dorm. You lie asleep under the covers. Pharos, the boy in striped pyjamas, stands by the window.
You push yourself up on your elbows and look at him. Then you sit on the edge of the bed, and Pharos stands in front of you.
Pharos holds out his hand. You reach out and take it, and the two of you hold hands.
Pharos has let go and stands back from you. A white flash fills the room. When it fades, he is gone, and you sit alone on the edge of the bed.
